mentions.name: Piktosaur
mentions.description: This is a photo gallery app for Windows that displays images from any folder and recursively searches nested folders, such as external hard drives, for additional images. It was built for the author's own personal use.
mentions.source_excerpt: Pretty much finished my photo gallery app for Windows -- https://github.com/Bloomca/Piktosaur. It is a pretty standard gallery viewer, the main feature is that you can point it at any folder and it will recursively search nested folders for extra images, e.g. an external hard drive.
